description: Wasserschutzgebiete in Oberösterreich is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by e-gov.ooe.gv.at. Water protection areas for the protection of existing and planned drinking water supply systems. The dataset is subject to an ongoing update. This dataset is made available via INSPIRE. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Water conservation areas in Upper Austria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Schutzzone, Berichterstattungseinheiten, Umwelt, HighValueDataset, Bewirtschaftungsgebiete, Schutzgebiete. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP, WFS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
